textbookText: - **Hydrogen spectral series — “L-B-P-B-F”:** **L**yman (n=1, UV) · **B**almer (n=2, visible) · **P**aschen (n=3, IR) · **B**rackett (n=4, IR) · **F**und (n=5, far IR). - **“K-H” of kinetic theory:** **K**E = ¾ kT · **P** = ⅛ ρc² — the two postulates to state in ANY KTG exam question. - **Gas-law constant mnemonics:** - **B**oyles = **P**-**V** (T fixed) · **C**harles = **V**-**T** (P fixed) · **G**ay-Lussac = **P**-**T** (V fixed) - “**PVG** always in **C**onstant order”: which one is held constant picks the law. - **Stoichiometry mnemonics:** **n = m/M**, **V = n × 22.4 L** (at STP), **% = act/theo**. - **Phase-change words:** “**S**olid→Gas = **S**ublimation · reverse = **D**eposition · **S**upercool = **S**tays liquid.
